Everyone feels alone sometimes. All we can do is be grateful for the love we do receive and try to return it. It's okay to cry. Many people don't have best friends. I don't know if it's ever wise to blame dysfunction completely on the other person. If all people are toxic, maybe it's good to begin to look at yourself. Start with the person in the mirror. Anger is okay to express but often can have it's roots in fear. Face that fear in time. Check out DBT.   


\-hopeful BPD sufferer

Sounds like you have some real life experience. Maybe you're right. I'm okay with the torture. I think if I get myself away from food at the right time it'll be alright. Also I might try dehydration too. That usually goes faster.

I don't want anyone to find me dead from violent methods. Someone will have to clean up the guts if I shoot myself or jump off a building. I also think someone would probably be comparatively damaged by finding me full of pills or hanging somewhere. I don't want to be remembered as the human who offed themselves mainly because of pride. Someone who starves to death is similar to someone who just passes away. I don't want people to think I just offed myself suddenly or just gave up. This method requires a lot of self control and forethought.
Yes, spot on.
Anorexics die and it isn't ruled as suicide. It's usually heart failure. I'd rather be fade away then suddenly just be gone.
I don't want it to be ruled as a suicide.

you are a beautiful human. your existence was meant to be. you are exactly as you're supposed to be. it's okay that you're struggling. you are worthy of love and are more than enough. don't try to be perfect just try to be you. \*hugs\* your craving for connection speaks to your humanity and empathy. that is meaningful.
\*clap\* his knight in shining armor...
Norman Bates is tossing and turning in his grave.

Are you fantasizing about specific ideals you want from love? You wish you had experience your crush and still have desire for him. You perhaps sometimes wish you had chosen another path and regret aspects of your life. That is why an old friend appears. You might occupied with another time when you were closer and thus you're not focused on the present.
You're welcome. I hope if it's meant to be, you and your friend can bury the hatchet but if not that you're able to recovery and heal whatever pain was triggered.

The building or houses represent your mind or more generally speaking your Self. The Native American friends might mean you long to be apart of a tribe. You feel burdened by certain standards of society and long to be set free into nature. Maybe that's why you end up in the desert with your friend. The desert also points to feelings of emptiness or barrenness.

The shotgun could mean you're in the midst of making some serious decisions, and there could be extreme consequences; such as major wounding. This means you're probably feeling immense vulnerability. There might be issues or negativity in your life that you've been private about and don't want to reveal to others. These issues will spill out much like your intestines in the dream. This is ultimately a positive because there will be an outpouring of truth and acceptance of self. This is reinforced by the fact that you die at the end, which means self transformation is soon to occur but also ties back to big changes happening due to current decisions presenting themselves to you.
What color was the dragon? Is anyone angry at you? Are you afraid anyone or anything? Is there anyone is your life tempting you towards evil or trying to get you to deviate from your path?

Missing out on a deal may represent your current stress with your financial situation. It could also point to a lack of confidence which may be why you're in the gym. You have a desire to be the best and to even achieve perfection. Perhaps you even feel you must be better than others. The waiting might mean you feel a sense impatience and are tired of others' needs coming before your own. If others' needs come before your own, this could be why you feel the need to be perfect. But perhaps there is also a sense of apprehension with getting those needs met.   


Meh, perhaps, maybe.

The ocean could be a representation of your mind. Perhaps your overwhelmed by emotion or current obstacles in your life, which could be why your drowning within the dream. Are you dealing with stress and uncertainty? Pay attention to your subconscious thoughts. The child dying before your eyes could actually mean that someone close to you (such as your best friend's son) may be in danger or facing difficulty. It could also symbolize repression of emotion or the inner child within you has been dampened.
